description: Queue products to be listed on a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted) within the listing automation's publishing windows and daily limit, a few at a time, instead of all at once — the same as the channel page's "Publish on schedule". Each queued product later goes up as a new listing through the same publisher as the Publish button, so a product missing something is reported in list_listing_jobs, not sent. Requires the connection's publishing to be turned on by the owner, and the owner's switch for AI marketplace publishing in Settings → Integrations → Connect AI. A product already listed, already queued or not on the channel is counted, never listed twice. Returns { queued, alreadyListed, alreadyQueued, notOnChannel }. Not idempotent beyond that guard. Echoes the workspace.

platform.description: The marketplace to publish on. Only vinted has listing automation today.

productIds.description: Product ids (1 to 100) from search_products or list_channel_products. Each must be a member of the channel without a live listing; the rest come back counted, never listed twice.
